# Repository-local agent tooling

## Purpose

Document the repository-local Ponytail + Graft runtime, bootstrap procedure, ownership boundaries, host support, and recovery/update operations for this concrete checkout.

Ponytail and Graft are pinned **inside this repository**, not installed globally.
Every launch resolves `.agent-tools/ponytail-graft/node_modules`, so two repos can
pin different versions and neither depends on a machine-wide install.

| Package | Pinned version |
|---|---|
| `@nanonets/graft` | 0.18.0 |
| `@dietrichgebert/ponytail` | 4.10.0 |

Integrity comes from `.agent-tools/ponytail-graft/package-lock.json`; `npm ci`
installs exactly those bytes.

## Bootstrap (required in every clone, on every machine)

```bash
node .agent-tools/ponytail-graft/bootstrap.cjs
```

Tracked wiring alone is not enough: `node_modules/` and the Graft graph are
ignored, and Graft's generated hook shims must be re-localized after each
`graft init`. Run bootstrap **before** opening an agent session in a fresh clone.
It is convergent — a second run changes nothing.

## Canonical Graft invocation

```bash
node .agent-tools/ponytail-graft/bin/graft.cjs <graft-arguments>
```

Any bare `graft ...` in generated Graft guidance means this launcher. A global
`graft` or `npx -y @nanonets/graft` would run a different version.

## Updating

Edit the exact versions in `.agent-tools/ponytail-graft/package.json`, then:

```bash
npm install --prefix .agent-tools/ponytail-graft
node .agent-tools/ponytail-graft/bootstrap.cjs
```

Bootstrap refuses to continue if the installed versions, `package.json` and
`package-lock.json` disagree.

## Uninstall

Remove `.agent-tools/ponytail-graft/`, the `ponytail:*` and
`ponytail-graft-local:*` fences from `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` and
`.github/copilot-instructions.md`, the `ponytail*` files under
`.cursor/rules/` and `.kiro/steering/`, the `ponytail*` skill directories under
`.claude/skills/` and `.agents/skills/`, and the `ponytail-hook.cjs` entries from
`.claude/settings.json`. `node .agent-tools/ponytail-graft/bin/graft.cjs retract`
removes Graft's own wiring.

## Host support

| Host | Graft | Ponytail |
|---|---|---|
| Claude Code | repo skill, MCP, hooks, statusline | repo instructions, skills, lifecycle hooks |
| Codex CLI/IDE | `AGENTS.md` + repo-local CLI | `AGENTS.md` + `.agents/skills/` |
| Cursor | repo rule, MCP, project hooks | repo rule |
| Kiro | repo steering, MCP | repo steering |
| GitHub Copilot | repo instructions + shell-accessible local CLI | repo instructions |

**Codex limitation.** Codex's MCP and hook registries are user-scoped
(`~/.codex/`), which this setup never writes. Codex therefore gets the
instruction tier plus the repo-local Graft CLI — not repo-local MCP or lifecycle
hooks. Instruction tier is real support, but it is not the native Ponytail
plugin: there is no automatic mode switching (`ultra`, `lite`, `off`) outside
Claude Code.

## Instruction fences

`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` and `.github/copilot-instructions.md` carry up to three
independent fenced regions. Edit only outside them; each is rewritten in place.

| Fence | Owner |
|---|---|
| `<!-- graft:start --> … <!-- graft:end -->` | Graft |
| `<!-- ponytail:start --> … <!-- ponytail:end -->` | this setup |
| `<!-- ponytail-graft-local:start --> … <!-- ponytail-graft-local:end -->` | this setup |

Graft additionally owns `.cursor/rules/graft.mdc`, `.kiro/steering/graft.md` and
`.claude/skills/graft/SKILL.md` wholesale — Ponytail never writes into those.

## One statusline

Claude Code allows exactly one `statusLine`. Graft's shows graph freshness and
token savings, so Graft keeps it and Ponytail's statusline is deliberately not
installed. A pre-existing foreign statusline is left alone by both.

## Ignored, regenerated by bootstrap

```text
.agent-tools/ponytail-graft/node_modules/   dependencies (npm ci)
.agent-tools/ponytail-graft/state/          per-repo Ponytail mode state
graft/                                      the Graft graph (graft build)
.claude/.ponytail-active                    active Ponytail mode flag
```
